metadata.title: PR 4 Smoke — ReleaseNotes (full GA + hotfix tolerance)

features.title: Approval routing policies
features.body: Teams can now target finance and engineering approvers with reusable routing presets and audit-ready conditions.

features.title: Variance workspace upgrades
features.body: Drill-through views load faster and preserve filter state across analyst handoffs for weekly reconciliation review.

features.title: Release dashboard subscriptions
features.body: Program managers can schedule digest snapshots directly to Teams and email without rebuilding scene templates.

fixes.title: Resolved duplicate notification sends when rollouts retried after timeout.
Fixed inconsistent totals in exported governance summaries.

breakingChanges.title: Legacy approval-policy IDs are removed from the public publish payload.
breakingChanges.mitigation: Regenerate payload contracts from the v2.4 SDK package or map old IDs to the new policyKey field before rollout.

fixes.title: Patched webhook retries to avoid duplicate release approvals.
Stabilized export jobs after transient storage throttling.
Corrected broken release note deep links in Teams digest cards.
